input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin object with schema_version toolbox-noaa-n2o-annual-growth-lookup-input-r0 and exactly integer start_year/end_year (2001–2100 inclusive; at most 50 years).
required_outputs: Provider-reported annual atmospheric N2O mole-fraction increases and stated uncertainties in ppb from the fixed raw table only, with explicit FOUND, PARTIAL_DATA, or NO_MATCH status.
One fixed raw-table receipt with retrieval time, HTTP metadata, response byte count and SHA-256, explicit request count, and claim ceiling; raw response is not retained.
